MOVE

AD walk · Shift run

Space jump · X super jump

Shift+Space while running: parkour tumble

Mountain: just walk up the slope; steep parts switch to hands-and-feet

CLIMB

E at the stairs

W up / S down the rope ladder

Space let go

MELEE

J punch combo · M front kick

K knife out / flip grip / put away

L throw knife

KNIFE

J stab · ▼+J gut cut

Reverse grip + J foot stab

Next to a stabbed enemy: hold E to pull, E+▼ gut, E+▲ split head

E near a foot-stabbed enemy yanks the knife out

REVOLVER

G draw / spin-holster · F fire

R reload · WS aim

SHOTGUN

Z pick up (stomp) / drop

F one barrel · B both

R reload · WS aim

HORSE

H mount / dismount

AD ride · Shift gallop · Space jump

K knife out · J slash enemies while riding

SWIM

AD swim · S dive

W/Space surface · push into a bank to climb out

ITEMS & OTHER

T pick up · C cigarette (again = flick)

O lantern · V man / woman · N night / day
